messages:
maya: Quick sync note from the authz postmortem: rotation job missed two namespaces due to a broken namespace regex after the cleanup. We successfully rotated two tokens manually but need durable fixes. Posting a compact action list, assign please.

alex: Thanks. Minimal plan: 1) make rotation idempotent + canary + CI e2e, 2) add recurring audit and alerts for long-lived tokens, 3) update runbook and perform immediate manual remediations.

cj: I'll take (1) rotation automation (RD-508). Work items: idempotent runner, canary flow, metric for rotation success/failure, e2e test that simulates config drift. Target: 2026-04-02 (end of sprint).

sophie: I'll own (2) alerts + dashboard + recurring audit (RD-509). Draft Splunk query and a draft pager policy by 2026-03-29.

maya: I'll do (3) runbook + manual rotations (RD-510). ETA for runbook update: 2026-03-28. I'll do manual rotation tonight for affected tokens and paste logs.

incident-bot: Created incident tickets: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/incident-zz12  (RD-508, RD-509, RD-510).

cj: Manual rotation logs for svc-payments and svc-billing: ```rot: svc-payments -> ok
rot: svc-billing -> ok
rot: svc-logger -> failed: path not found```

sophie: svc-logger looks like it's still using the legacy secret path /secret/keymaster/legacy. I'll open infra-ops ticket to remap.

security-eng: FYI I'm running a quick scan to enumerate services using the legacy path and tokens >60d TTL. Will share CSV before Thursday.

alex: Add recurring audit rule: flag tokens TTL > 60 days and any manual-exempt annotations. Sophie, include this in RD-509. Also add an alert when rotation job failure metric > 0 for 2 consecutive runs.

sophie: Working Splunk query (WIP): ```index=auth_logs sourcetype=token_logs | where ttl_days > 60 OR secret_path LIKE "/secret/keymaster/legacy%" | stats count by service, token_id``` Will put into dashboard tile and alert.

cj: I'll push PR that adds rotation success/failure counter and CI e2e simulating regex drift (PR 4401). Also adding a canary flag so we can test on a non-prod namespace first.

maya: Summary of ownership: RD-508 -> cj -> 2026-04-02; RD-509 -> sophie -> draft 2026-03-29; RD-510 -> maya -> 2026-03-28. If anyone needs to reassign shout here.

alex: Quick sync scheduled Tue 2026-03-31 09:00 PT (15m). We aim to close incident by 2026-04-12 if all remediations pass.

security-eng: Scan results attached in board and added two more services with legacy paths. Marking them blockers for RD-508.

sophie: I'll include those in the audit and add temporary pager schedule for next week to watch the new alert.

cj: A note on testing: the e2e will fail loudly (non-zero exit) so CI will block merges if rotation can't reach >95% targeted namespaces.

maya: Manual rotations for the three affected tokens completed; logs: ```rot svc-payments ok
rot svc-billing ok
rot svc-logger ok (after infra path remap)```

alex: Great work. I'll update the incident doc and mark the follow-up board. Thanks all.
